WHO I AM

ABOUT.

MAYANK
GUPTA
CURIOUS / HANDS-ON / ALWAYS BUILDING

I build things that solve problems.

My aim is to secure a strong opportunity in the industrial and technology sector, where I can put practical, hands-on engineering to work. I'm currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science at Lovely Professional University.

I like projects with a visible, physical outcome — an automatic water dispenser, an ultrasonic radar, a smart dustbin, and a sensing stick to help people navigate. I work with HTML, CSS, Java, Python, C and C++, and I'm comfortable with core data structures, algorithms and database fundamentals.
